videos.title: Act, Confirm, or Stop? Smarter behavior for AI assistants, wearables & robots — Amit Desai, Roku
videos.summary: Chasing 100% model accuracy in voice AI is a losing battle—the real secret to delighting users is optimizing how your system behaves when it is uncertain. By implementing the Outcome User Cost Heuristic (OUCH) framework to decide when an assistant should act, confirm, or stop, you can drastically cut user friction and boost satisfaction without altering your underlying models. Watch this talk to discover how math-driven decision thresholds can transform clumsy voice assistants and embodied AI into intuitive, low-friction experiences.

videos.title: "My name is... my name is...": A Linguistic Map for Voice Agents — Midam Kim, ServiceNow
videos.summary: Most voice AI bots fail not because of poor speech-to-text models, but because they treat conversations as static pipelines instead of dynamic, collaborative human activities. By mapping dialogue across four interdependent linguistic layers—sounds, words, turn-taking interactions, and evolving mental models—this talk reveals the exact framework needed to prevent catastrophic bot breakdowns. Watch to discover how engineering around real-time linguistic orchestration turns frustrating voice agents into seamless conversational partners.

timestamps.topic: Human Communication as a Joint Activity
